title: UK Autumn Budget 2026 — Chancellor's statement plus the OBR Economic and Fiscal Outlook (Westminster)
source: NEWS: press-reported, not primary-verified. Multiple independent UK professional-services and tax publishers (PwC UK budget hub, RBS/Coutts 'key dates', rossmartin.co.uk, uktax.tools, several accountancy firms) all read 'Wednesday 28 October 2026' for Chancellor John Healey's first Budget, each stating the OBR will publish an updated economic and fiscal forecast the same day, as the Budget Responsibility and National Audit Act 2011 requires. No gov.uk or obr.uk page was fetched directly this session, so the prefix stays NEWS: rather than being upgraded on corroboration count. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of boe-decision-2026-09-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE boe-decision-2026-09-17 LANE, 2026-09-09. It is filed because it is the fiscal half of the gilt-supply question the 09-17 MPC QT review opens: the 2026-09-08 30-year gilt syndication cleared at 5.8168%, the highest yield at any DMO auction since 1998, with press coverage tying it directly to expectations of tax rises at this Budget. Two supply decisions therefore land five weeks apart on the same curve — the Bank's annual APF reduction target (09-17) and the DMO's remit arithmetic (10-28) — and the DMO has already cut long conventional gilt issuance to GBP 23bn, about 9% of 2026-27 supply, on 'declining structural demand ... from domestic pension funds'. Tiered LOW and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: symbols: [], no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, and the route to this book is the same second-order global-term-premium channel fomc-2026-09-16 owns. Kind is geopolitical rather than macro-print because it is a policy set-piece with a date, not a statistical release. Estimate + a NEWS: prefix widen caution only; nothing date-keyed may act on this.
